notes: The margins' *had delight continually* and *Sporting* were read and set aside under rule 38.

Flagged large-source-unit s015-s017 checked morpheme by morpheme: `בְּ` states the temporal relation, `כֹּל` the universality and `עֵת` the time, and *always* carries all three with no English word owning any part of one of them, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the grouping is retained. The head goes to `כֹּל` as the morpheme governing the rest under rule 23's tie paragraph; heading on `עֵת` was the available alternative.

`יוֹם יוֹם` is carried whole by the lone adverb *daily*, which spends nothing on either occurrence in particular, so rule 22's limit sends it to rule 30's fusion rather than leaving the repetition `unrepresented`.

The italic *his* is `added` under rule 18's closing sentence, no suffix or other possessive morpheme standing in the clause; *as* is the supplied word stating what the bare nominal `אָמוֹן` contributes, under rule 33, and *master workman* heads on *workman*, which carries the lexeme.
